{07 15 00}WHAT?! {01 00 00 05 00}Why are you all up in
my business?{01 01 00}{01 08 00} NO, I HAVEN'T
CAUGHT THE BUG YET!
{07 16 00}But {01 00 00 05 00}just you wait and see,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}I still haven't found a bug
that's worthy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Yeah, I'm choosy.
{07 01 00}But so what?! {01 01 00}{07 06 00}I'll find one
that'll make your eyes bug
out and your brain melt!
